# chameleon_workspaces (Data Source)

List all workspaces visible to the caller (all of them for a platform admin).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all workspaces visible to the caller (all of them for a platform admin).
data "chameleon_workspaces" "all" {}

output "workspace_slugs" {
  value = data.chameleon_workspaces.all.slugs
}

output "workspaces" {
  value = data.chameleon_workspaces.all.workspaces
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slugs` (List of String) Workspace slugs.
- `workspaces` (Attributes List) All workspaces with their attributes (catalogs are not included here; use the chameleon_workspace data source for those). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))
